text:
Opened soil can't be returned unless it's faulty. If your bag is faulty, you can return it within **30 days** of delivery. Start the return from "My Orders", and a prepaid label will be emailed to you (it expires after **7 days**, so drop it off within that window). Faulty items return free, and your refund is issued within **5 business days** of the return reaching our warehouse.

If the bag was unopened and unused, it can also be returned within 30 days, but a change-of-mind return costs a flat **$6.95** (free for Leafy Plus members).
